acquisition method: MS and MS/MS data were obtained using the TOP10 method.
cleavage agent: Bands corresponding to 25 kDa and 50 kDa for MaSp1pla and 25 kDa for MaSp1nuc were excised, destained, and digested with TPCK-treated trypsin (Worthington Biochemical Corporation, US).
enrichment method: Total soluble proteins from MaSp1 nuc and MaSp1 pla lines were His-trap purified as previously described (Foong et al., )
fractionation method: Total soluble proteins from MaSp1 nuc and MaSp1 pla lines were His-trap purified as previously described (Foong et al., ) and resolved on SDS-PAGE gels (4%–20% Mini‐PROTEAN TGX, Bio‐Rad, US).
instrument: Q Exactive Hybrid Quadrupole‐Orbitrap mass spectrometer
applied to a Q Exactive Hybrid Quadrupole‐Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, US).
